name: Wuli Xi de Wo, Leguan Pai de Ta
original_name: 无力系的我，乐观派的她
source:
"To all the seventeen-year-olds with endless possibilities."

This is a male-oriented visual light novel (Galgame) themed around youth and romance. After being promoted to the second year of high school, you’re informed that the school will stop admitting new students. Your childhood friend, Kokoro Natsuka, is determined to prevent the school from closing down. Just as you—an unmotivated person—are about to be reluctantly dragged into her plan by the optimistic her, an unexpected incident occurs… You have to rewind the seemingly endless end of summer, make different choices and actions, and save your relationship with her.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3846750/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“献给所有拥有无限可能的十七岁少年。”

这是一部以青春、浪漫为主题的男性向视觉轻小说（Galgame）。升入高二后，你被告知学校将停止招收新生。你儿时的朋友夏香心决心阻止学校关闭。正当你这个没有动力的人，即将被乐观的她无奈地拖入她的计划时，意想不到的事件发生了……你必须将看似无尽的夏天结束，做出不同的选择和行动，拯救你和她的关系。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3846750/]Steam[/url]]
